note:
Build the #84 stress set for the general-adult-3 red-flag screen (synthetic text only; deterministic).

python3 build_set.py  ->  stress-set.json

Positives: hand-written lay phrasings for every approved red flag (RF01-RF19), each placed in several styles: plain,
typos, texting slang, a long rambling story, buried in one answer among unrelated answers, after a negation of other
signs ("no fever, but ..."), and non-native English. A positive passes when the screen routes it at the red flag's level
or higher. Negatives: look-alikes, negations, resolved or hypothetical mentions and other people, in two styles each;
any red flag on a negative is a false alarm. Labels follow the approved RF wording, not a clinical judgment of risk.
